title: Build a Citation Scanner
text: scan_usage() inspects .R, .Rmd, .qmd files package attachments (library(), require()) function calls (pkg::fun() unqualified calls resolved attachment order). strict = TRUE aborts calls resolved unambiguously; default, strict = FALSE, warns omits instead.
code: project <- tempfile("stan-project-") dir.create(project) script <- file.path(project, "analysis.R")  writeLines(   c(     "library(cmdstanr)",     "library(posterior)",     "fit <- cmdstan_model('model.stan')$sample()",     "draws <- fit$draws()",     "summarise_draws(draws)",     "bayesplot::mcmc_hist(draws)"   ),   script )  usage <- scan_usage(   project,   universe,   strict = TRUE )  usage unlink(project, recursive = TRUE)

title: Static Detection and Citation of R Package and Function Usage
text: scanner records function calls, function references. ignores lapply(x, mean) purrr::map(x, sd). built-Markdown parser recognizes R chunks headed {r}. Plain fenced blocks r info string skipped. Package attachments tracked within file. setup script calls library() establish attachment state another file. Default package citations require package installed. Supply package_citations packages unavailable locally. Scanning namespace inspects bindings R6 classes. Active bindings can run getters, unusually deep generated expressions can exceed R’s recursion limits.

title: ascribe: Static Detection and Citation of R Package and Function Usage — ascribe-package
text: Scans R source files package function use, builds citations configurable package universes. Supports .R, .Rmd, .qmd files, resolves unqualified calls attachment order re-export origin, leaves package collection define citations. See 'stanflow' https://github.com/VisruthSK/stanflow example usage.
